meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能创建和编辑 Obsidian 等应用使用的 JSON Canvas(.canvas)文件：写入 text、file、link、group 四类节点和连接节点的 edges，并按规格校验 id 与必填字段。
howto.when: 当你要处理 .canvas 文件，或要求创建可视化画布、思维导图、流程图，或提到 Obsidian 里的 Canvas 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几个要点做成一个 Canvas 思维导图。
say.note: 会生成含文字节点和连线的 .canvas 文件。

say.text: 给我的 .canvas 加一个指向 PDF 的 file 节点。
say.note: 按规格更新 nodes，保留原节点。

say.text: 画一个带判定分支的流程图，存成 .canvas。
say.note: 生成 text 节点和带箭头的 edges。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and edit valid JSON Canvas (.canvas) files for Obsidian and other apps. It writes node and edge objects (text, file, link, group) with positions, sizes, colors, labels, and validates IDs and required fields.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with .canvas files, ask to create visual canvases, mind maps, or flowcharts, or mention Canvas files in Obsidian.

say_en.text: Turn these bullet points into a Canvas mind map.
say_en.note: Creates a .canvas file with text nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Add a file node pointing to a PDF in my .canvas.
say_en.note: Updates nodes while keeping existing ones.

say_en.text: Draw a flowchart with a decision branch and save it as .canvas.
say_en.note: Generates text nodes and arrow edges.
